manifestations.invariant: After a partial grade, a rejected lot has its accepted settlement voided exactly once and every returned bin is present in field inventory.

contract_bindings.quote: The grader ledger reconciles each lot's accepted weight before settlement.
The rejected-lot test checks that field inventory contains returned bins after rejection, while recorded grade entries are voided.
